morceaux.1: Ars Amatoria Liber secundus P. OVIDI NASONIS LIBER SECVNDVS ARTIS AMATORIAE
morceaux.2:
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="1">Dicite <quote>'io Paean!'</quote> et <quote>'io'</quote> bis dicite <quote>'Paean!'</quote></l>
  <l n="2"><pb n="2"/>Decidit in casses praeda petita meos;</l>
  <l n="3">Laetus amans donat viridi mea carmina palma,</l>
  <l n="4">Praelata Ascraeo Maeonioque seni.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="5">Talis ab armiferis Priameius hospes Amyclis</l>
  <l n="6">Candida cum rapta coniuge vela dedit;</l>
  <l n="7">Talis erat qui te curru victore ferebat,</l>
  <l n="8">Vecta peregrinis Hippodamia rotis.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="9">Quid properas, iuvenis? mediis tua pinus in undis</l>
  <l n="10">Navigat, et longe quem peto portus abest.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="11">Non satis est venisse tibi me vate puellam:</l>
  <l n="12">Arte mea capta est, arte tenenda mea est.</l>
  <l n="13">Nec minor est virtus, quam quaerere, parta tueri:</l>
  <l n="14">Casus inest illic; hoc erit artis opus.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="15">Nunc mihi, siquando, puer et Cytherea, favete,</l>
  <l n="16">Nunc Erato, nam tu nomen amoris habes.</l>
  <l n="17">Magna paro, quas possit Amor remanere per artes,</l>
  <l n="18">Dicere, tam vasto pervagus orbe puer.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="19">Et levis est, et habet geminas, quibus avolet, alas:</l>
  <l n="20">Difficile est illis inposuisse modum.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="21">Hospitis effugio praestruxerat omnia Minos:</l>
  <l n="22">Audacem pinnis repperit ille viam.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="23">Daedalus ut clausit conceptum crimine matris</l>
  <l n="24">Semibovemque virum semivirumque bovem,</l>
  <l n="25"><pb n="3"/>'Sit modus exilio,' dixit 'iustissime Minos:</l>
  <l n="26">Accipiat cineres terra paterna meos.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="27">Et quoniam in patria, fatis agitatus iniquis,</l>
  <l n="28">Vivere non potui, da mihi posse mori.</l>
  <l n="29">Da reditum puero, senis est si gratia vilis:</l>
  <l n="30">Si non vis puero parcere, parce seni.'</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="31">Dixerat haec; sed et haec et multo plura licebat</l>
  <l n="32">Dicere: regressus non dabat ille viro.</l>
</lg>
morceaux.3:
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="33">Quod simul ut sensit, '<persName>Daedale</persName>,' dixit:</l>
  <l n="34">'nunc, nunc, o <persName>Daedale</persName>,' dixit:</l>
  <l n="35">Materiam, qua sis ingeniosus, habes.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="36">Possidet et terras et possidet <name type="deity" xml:lang="la">Minos</name>:</l>
  <l n="37">Nec tellus nostrae nec patet unda fugae.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="38">Restat iter caeli: caelo temptabimus ire.</l>
  <l n="39">Da veniam coepto, <name type="deity" xml:lang="la">Iupiter</name> alte, meo:</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="40">Non ego sidereas adfecto tangere sedes:</l>
  <l n="41">Qua fugiam dominum, nulla, nisi ista, via est.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="42">Per <name type="placeName" xml:lang="la">Styga</name> detur iter, <name type="placeName" xml:lang="la">Stygias</name> transnabimus undas;</l>
  <l n="43">Sunt mihi naturae iura novanda meae.'</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="44">Ingenium mala saepe movent: quis crederet umquam</l>
  <l n="45">Aerias hominem carpere posse vias?</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="46">Remigium <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">volucrum</name> disponit in ordine pinnas,</l>
  <l n="47">Et leve per lini vincula nectit opus,</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="48">Imaque pars ceris adstringitur igne solutis,</l>
  <l n="49">Finitusque novae iam labor artis erat.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="50">Tractabat ceramque puer pinnasque renidens,</l>
  <l n="51">Nescius haec umeris arma parata suis.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="52">Cui pater 'his' inquit 'patria est adeunda carinis,</l>
  <l n="53">Hac nobis <name type="deity" xml:lang="la">Minos</name> effugiendus ope.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="54">Aera non potuit <name type="deity" xml:lang="la">Minos</name>, alia omnia clausit;</l>
  <l n="55">Quem licet, inventis aera rumpe meis.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="56">Sed tibi non <persName>virgo Tegeaea</persName> comesque <persName>Bootae</persName></l>
  <l n="57"><name type="deity" xml:lang="la">Orion</name> aspiciendus erit:</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="58">Me pinnis sectare datis; ego praevius ibo:</l>
  <l n="59">Sit tua cura sequi; me duce tutus eris.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="60">Nam sive aetherias vicino sole per auras</l>
  <l n="61">Ibimus, impatiens cera caloris erit:</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="62">Sive humiles propiore freto iactabimus alas,</l>
  <l n="63">Mobilis aequoreis pinna madescet aquis.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="64">Inter utrumque vola; ventos quoque, nate, timeto,</l>
  <l n="65">Quaque ferent aurae, vela secunda dato.'</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="66">Dum monet, aptat opus puero, monstratque moveri,</l>
</lg>
morceaux.4:
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="66">Erudit infirmas ut sua mater <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">aves</name>.</l>
  <l n="67">Inde sibi factas umeris accommodat alas,</l>
  <l n="68">Perque novum timide corpora librat iter.</l>
  <l n="69">Iamque volaturus parvo dedit oscula nato,</l>
  <l n="70">Nec patriae lacrimas continuere genae.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="71">Monte minor collis, campis erat altior aequis:</l>
  <l n="72">Hinc data sunt miserae corpora bina fugae.</l>
  <l n="73">Et movet ipse suas, et nati respicit alas</l>
  <l n="74">Daedalus, et cursus sustinet usque suos.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="75">Iamque novum delectat iter, positoque timore</l>
  <l n="76">Icarus audaci fortius arte volat.</l>
  <l n="77">Hos aliquis, tremula dum captat arundine <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">pisces</name>,</l>
  <l n="78">Vidit, et inceptum dextra reliquit opus.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="79">Iam Samos a laeva (fuerant Naxosque relictae</l>
  <l n="80">Et Paros et Clario Delos amata <name type="deity">deo</name>)</l>
  <l n="81">Dextra Lebinthos erat silvisque umbrosa Calymne</l>
  <l n="82">Cinctaque piscosis Astypalaea vadis,</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="83">Cum puer, incautis nimium temerarius annis,</l>
  <l n="84">Altius egit iter, deseruitque patrem.</l>
  <l n="85">Vincla labant, et cera deo propiore liquescit,</l>
  <l n="86">Nec tenues ventos brachia mota tenent.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="87">Territus a summo despexit in aequora caelo:</l>
  <l n="88">Nox oculis pavido venit oborta metu.</l>
  <l n="89">Tabuerant cerae: nudos quatit ille lacertos,</l>
  <l n="90">Et trepidat nec, quo sustineatur, habet.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="91">Decidit, atque cadens 'pater, o pater, auferor!' inquit,</l>
  <l n="92">Clauserunt virides ora loquentis <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">aquae</name>.</l>
  <l n="93">At pater infelix, nec iam pater, 'Icare!' clamat,</l>
  <l n="94">'Icare,' clamat 'ubi es, quoque sub axe volas?'</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="95">'Icare' clamabat, pinnas aspexit in undis.</l>
  <l n="96">Ossa tegit tellus: aequora nomen habent.</l>
  <l n="97">Non potuit Minos hominis conpescere pinnas;</l>
</lg>
morceaux.5:
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="98">Ipse deum <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">volucrem</name> detinuisse paro.</l>
  <l n="99">Fallitur, Haemonias siquis decurrit ad artes,</l>
  <l n="100">Datque quod a teneri fronte revellit <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">equi</name>.</l>
  <l n="101">Non facient, ut vivat amor, Medeides <name type="plant" xml:lang="la">herbae</name></l>
  <l n="102">Mixtaque cum magicis nenia Marsa sonis.</l>
  <l n="103"><persName>Phasias</persName> <persName>Aesoniden</persName>, <persName>Circe</persName> tenuisset <persName>Ulixem</persName>,</l>
  <l n="104">Si modo servari carmine posset amor.</l>
  <l n="105">Nec data profuerint pallentia philtra puellis:</l>
  <l n="106">Philtra nocent animis, vimque furoris habent.</l>
  <l n="107">Sit procul omne nefas; ut ameris, amabilis esto:</l>
  <l n="108">Quod tibi non facies solave forma dabit:</l>
  <l n="109">Sis licet antiquo <persName>Nireus</persName> adamatus <name type="deity">Homero</name>,</l>
  <l n="110"><name type="deity">Naiadum</name>que tener crimine raptus <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">Hylas</name>,</l>
  <l n="111">Ut dominam teneas, nec te mirere relictum,</l>
  <l n="112">Ingenii dotes corporis adde bonis.</l>
  <l n="113">Forma bonum fragile est, quantumque accedit ad annos</l>
  <l n="114">Fit minor, et spatio carpitur ipsa suo.</l>
  <l n="115">Nec <name type="plant" xml:lang="la">violae</name> semper nec hiantia <name type="plant" xml:lang="la">lilia</name> florent,</l>
  <l n="116">Et riget amissa spina relicta <name type="plant" xml:lang="la">rosa</name>.</l>
  <l n="117">Et tibi iam venient <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">cani</name>, formose, <name type="plant" xml:lang="la">capilli</name>,</l>
  <l n="118">Iam venient rugae, quae tibi corpus arent.</l>
  <l n="119">Iam molire animum, qui duret, et adstrue formae:</l>
  <l n="120">Solus ad extremos permanet ille rogos.</l>
  <l n="121">Nec levis ingenuas pectus coluisse per artes</l>
  <l n="122">Cura sit et linguas edidicisse duas.</l>
  <l n="123">Non formosus erat, sed erat facundus <persName>Ulixes</persName>,</l>
  <l n="124">Et tamen aequoreas torsit amore <name type="deity">deas</name>.</l>
  <l n="125">A quotiens illum doluit properare <persName>Calypso</persName>,</l>
  <l n="126">Remigioque aptas esse negavit <name type="placeName">aquas</name>!</l>
  <l n="127">Haec <placeName>Troiae</placeName> casus iterumque iterumque rogabat:</l>
  <l n="128">Ille referre aliter saepe solebat idem.</l>
  <l n="129">Litore constiterant: illic quoque pulchra <persName>Calypso</persName></l>
</lg>
morceaux.6:
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="130">Exigit <name type="deity" xml:lang="la">Odrysii</name> fata cruenta ducis.</l>
  <l n="131">Ille levi virga (virgam nam forte tenebat)</l>
  <l n="132">Quod rogat, in spisso litore pingit opus.</l>
  <l n="133">'Haec' inquit '<placeName>Troia</placeName> est' (muros in litore fecit):</l>
  <l n="134">'Hic tibi sit <placeName>Simois</placeName>; haec mea castra puta.</l>
  <l n="135">Campus erat' (campumque facit), 'quem caede <persName>Dolonis</persName></l>
  <l n="136">Sparsimus, <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">Haemonios</name> dum vigil optat <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">equos</name>.</l>
  <l n="137">Illic <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">Sithonii</name> fuerant tentoria <persName>Rhesi</persName>:</l>
  <l n="138">Hac ego sum captis nocte revectus <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">equis</name>.'</l>
  <l n="139">Pluraque pingebat, subitus cum <placeName>Pergama</placeName> fluctus</l>
  <l n="140">Abstulit et <persName>Rhesi</persName> cum duce castra suo.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="141">Tum <name type="deity">dea</name> 'quas' inquit 'fidas tibi credis ituro,</l>
  <l n="142">Perdiderint undae nomina quanta, vides?'</l>
  <l n="143">Ergo age, fallaci timide confide figurae,</l>
  <l n="144">Quisquis es, aut aliquid corpore pluris habe.</l>
  <l n="145">Dextera praecipue capit indulgentia mentes;</l>
  <l n="146">Asperitas odium saevaque bella movet.</l>
  <l n="147">Odimus <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">accipitrem</name>, quia vivit semper in armis,</l>
  <l n="148">Et pavidum solitos in pecus ire <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">lupos</name>.</l>
  <l n="149">At caret insidiis hominum, quia mitis, <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">hirundo</name>,</l>
  <l n="150">Quasque colat turres, <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">Chaonis</name> ales habet.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="151">Este procul, lites et amarae proelia linguae:</l>
  <l n="152">Dulcibus est verbis mollis alendus amor.</l>
  <l n="153">Lite fugent nuptaeque viros nuptasque mariti,</l>
  <l n="154">Inque vicem credant res sibi semper agi;</l>
  <l n="155">Hoc decet uxores; dos est uxoria lites:</l>
  <l n="156">Audiat optatos semper amica sonos.</l>
  <l n="157">Non legis iussu lectum venistis in unum:</l>
  <l n="158">Fungitur in vobis munere legis amor.</l>
  <l n="159">Blanditias molles auremque iuvantia verba</l>
  <l n="160">Adfer, ut adventu laeta sit illa tuo.</l>
  <l n="161">Non ego divitibus venio praeceptor amandi:</l>
</lg>
morceaux.7:
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="1">Nil opus est illi, qui dabit, arte mea;</l>
  <l n="2">Secum habet ingenium, qui, cum libet, 'accipe' dicit;</l>
  <l n="3">Cedimus: inventis plus placet ille meis.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="4">Pauperibus vates ego sum, quia pauper amavi;</l>
  <l n="5">Cum dare non possem munera, verba dabam.</l>
  <l n="6">Pauper amet caute: timeat maledicere pauper,</l>
  <l n="7">Multaque divitibus non patienda ferat.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="8">Me memini iratum dominae turbasse capillos:</l>
  <l n="9">Haec mihi quam multos abstulit ira dies!</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="10">Nec puto, nec sensi tunicam laniasse; sed ipsa</l>
  <l n="11">Dixerat, et pretio est illa redempta meo.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="12">At vos, si sapitis, vestri peccata magistri</l>
  <l n="13">Effugite, et culpae damna timete meae.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="14">Proelia cum Parthis, cum culta pax sit amica,</l>
  <l n="15">Et iocus, et causas quicquid amoris habet.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="16">Si nec blanda satis, nec erit tibi comis amanti,</l>
  <l n="17">Perfer et obdura: postmodo mitis erit.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="18">Flectitur obsequio curvatus ab arbore ramus:</l>
  <l n="19">Frangis, si vires experiere tuas.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="20">Obsequio tranantur aquae: nec vincere possis</l>
  <l n="21">Flumina, si contra, quam rapit unda, nates.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="22">Obsequium tigresque domat Numidasque leones;</l>
  <l n="23">Rustica paulatim taurus aratra subit.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="24">Quid fuit asperius Nonacrina Atalanta?</l>
  <l n="25">Succubuit meritis trux tamen illa viri.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="26">Saepe suos casus nec mitia facta puellae</l>
  <l n="27">Flesse sub arboribus Milaniona ferunt;</l>
  <l n="28">Saepe tulit iusso fallacia retia collo,</l>
  <l n="29">Saepe fera torvos cuspide fixit apros:</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="30">Sensit et Hylaei contentum saucius arcum:</l>
  <l n="31">Sed tamen hoc arcu notior alter erat.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="32">Non te Maenalias armatum scandere silvas,</l>
  <l n="33">Nec iubeo collo retia ferre tuo:</l>
</lg>
morceaux.8:
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="195">Pectora nec missis iubeo praebere <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">sagittis</name>;</l>
  <l n="196">Artis erunt cauto mollia iussa meae.</l>
  <l n="197">Cede repugnanti: cedendo victor abibis:</l>
  <l n="198">Fac modo, quas partes illa iubebit, agas.</l>
  <l n="199">Arguet, arguito; quicquid probat illa, probato;</l>
  <l n="200">Quod dicet, dicas; quod negat illa, neges.</l>
  <l n="201">Riserit, adride; si flebit, flere memento;</l>
  <l n="202">Imponat leges vultibus illa tuis.</l>
  <l n="203">Seu ludet, numerosque manu iactabit eburnos,</l>
  <l n="204">Tu male iactato, tu male iacta dato:</l>
  <l n="205">Seu iacies <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">talos</name>, victam ne poena sequatur,</l>
  <l n="206">Damnosi facito stent tibi saepe <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">canes</name>:</l>
  <l n="207">Sive latrocinii sub imagine <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">calculus</name> ibit,</l>
  <l n="208">Fac pereat vitreo miles ab hoste tuo.</l>
  <l n="209">Ipse tene distenta suis umbracula virgis,</l>
  <l n="210">Ipse fac in turba, qua venit illa, locum.</l>
  <l n="211">Nec dubita tereti scamnum producere lecto,</l>
  <l n="212">Et tenero soleam deme vel adde pedi.</l>
  <l n="213">Saepe etiam dominae, quamvis horrebis et ipse,</l>
  <l n="214">Algenti manus est calfacienda sinu.</l>
  <l n="215">Nec tibi turpe puta (quamvis sit turpe, placebit),</l>
  <l n="216">Ingenua speculum sustinuisse manu.</l>
  <l n="217">Ille, fatigata praebendo monstra noverca</l>
  <l n="218">Qui meruit caelum, quod prior ipse tulit,</l>
  <l n="219">Inter Ioniacas <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">calathum</name> tenuisse puellas</l>
  <l n="220">Creditur, et <name type="plant" xml:lang="la">lanas</name> excoluisse rudes.</l>
  <l n="221">Paruit imperio dominae Tirynthius heros:</l>
  <l n="222">I nunc et dubita ferre, quod ille tulit.</l>
  <l n="223">Iussus adesse foro, iussa maturius hora</l>
  <l n="224">Fac semper venias, nec nisi serus abi.</l>
  <l n="225">Occurras aliquo, tibi dixerit: omnia differ,</l>
  <l n="226">Curre, nec inceptum turba moretur iter.</l>
  <l n="227">Nocte domum repetens epulis perfuncta redibit:</l>
</lg>
morceaux.9:
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="230">Tum quoque pro servo, si vocat illa, veni.</l>
  <l n="231">Rure erit, et dicet 'venias': Amor odit inertes:</l>
  <l n="232">Si rota defuerit, tu pede carpe viam.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="233">Nec grave te tempus sitiensque <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">Canicula</name> tardet,</l>
  <l n="234">Nec via per iactas candida facta <foreign xml:lang="la">nives</foreign>.</l>
  <l n="235">Militiae species amor est; discedite, segnes:</l>
  <l n="236">Non sunt haec timidis signa tuenda viris.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="237">Nox et hiems longaeque viae saevique dolores</l>
  <l n="238">Mollibus his castris et labor omnis inest.</l>
  <l n="239">Saepe feres imbrem caelesti nube solutum,</l>
  <l n="240">Frigidus et nuda saepe iacebis humo.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="241"><name type="deity">Cynthius</name> <persName>Admeti</persName> <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">vaccas</name> pavisse <placeName>Pheraei</placeName></l>
  <l n="242">Fertur, et in parva delituisse casa.</l>
  <l n="243">Quod <persName>Phoebum</persName> decuit, quem non decet? exue fastus,</l>
  <l n="244">Curam mansuri quisquis amoris habes.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="245">Si tibi per tutum planumque negabitur ire,</l>
  <l n="246">Atque erit opposita ianua fulta sera,</l>
  <l n="247">At tu per praeceps tecto delabere aperto:</l>
  <l n="248">Det quoque furtivas alta fenestra vias.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="249">Laeta erit, et causam tibi se sciet esse pericli;</l>
  <l n="250">Hoc dominae certi pignus amoris erit.</l>
  <l n="251">Saepe tua poteras, <persName>Leandre</persName>, carere puella:</l>
  <l n="252">Transnabas, animum nosset ut illa tuum.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="253">Nec pudor ancillas, ut quaeque erit ordine prima,</l>
  <l n="254">Nec tibi sit servos demeruisse pudor.</l>
  <l n="255">Nomine quemque suo (nulla est iactura) saluta,</l>
  <l n="256">Iunge tuis humiles, ambitiose, manus.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="257">Sed tamen et servo (levis est inpensa) roganti</l>
  <l n="258">Porrige <persName>Fortunae</persName> munera parva die:</l>
  <l n="259">Porrige et ancillae, qua poenas luce pependit</l>
  <l n="260">Lusa maritali <foreign xml:lang="la">Gallica</foreign> veste manus.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="261">Fac plebem, mihi crede, tuam; sit semper in illa</l>
</lg>
morceaux.10: Halieutica Ianitor et thalami qui iacet ante fores. Nec dominam iubeo pretioso munere dones: Parva, sed e parvis callidus apta dato. Dum bene dives ager, cum rami pondere nutant, Adferat in calatho rustica dona puer. Rure suburbano poteris tibi dicere missa, Illa vel in Sacra sint licet empta via. Adferat aut uvas, aut quas Amaryllis amabat++ At nunc castaneas non amat illa nuces. Quin etiam turdoque missaque columba Te memorem dominae testificere tuae. Turpiter his emitur spes mortis et orba senectus. A, pereant, per quos munera crimen habent! Quid tibi praecipiam teneros quoque mittere versus? Ei mihi, non multum carmen honoris habet. Carmina laudantur, sed munera magna petuntur: Dummodo sit dives, barbarus ipse placet. Aurea sunt vere nunc saecula: plurimus auro Venit honos: auro conciliatur amor. Ipse licet venias Musis comitatus, Homere, Si nihil attuleris, ibis, Homere, foras. Sunt tamen et doctae, rarissima turba, puellae; Altera non doctae turba, sed esse volunt. Utraque laudetur per carmina: carmina lector Commendet dulci qualiacumque sono; His ergo aut illis vigilatum carmen in ipsas Forsitan exigui muneris instar erit. At quod eris per te facturus, et utile credis, Id tua te facito semper amica roget. Libertas alicui fuerit promissa tuorum: Hanc tamen a domina fac petat ille tua: Si poenam servo, si vincula saeva remittis,
morceaux.11:
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="291">Quod facturus eras, debeat illa tibi:</l>
  <l n="292">Utilitas tua sit, titulus donetur amicae:</l>
  <l n="293">Perde nihil, partes illa potentis agat.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="294">Sed te, cuicumque est retinendae cura puellae,</l>
  <l n="295">Attonitum forma fac putet esse sua.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="296">Sive erit in Tyriis, Tyrios laudabis amictus:</l>
  <l n="297">Sive erit in Cois, Coa decere puta.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="298">Aurata est? ipso tibi sit pretiosior auro;</l>
  <l n="299">Gausapa si sumpsit, gausapa sumpta proba.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="300">Astiterit tunicata, 'moves incendia' clama,</l>
  <l n="301">Sed timida, caveat frigora, voce roga.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="302">Conpositum discrimen erit, discrimina lauda:</l>
  <l n="303">Torserit igne comam, torte capille, place.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="304">Brachia saltantis, vocem mirare canentis,</l>
  <l n="305">Et, quod desierit, verba querentis habe.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="306">Ipsos concubitus, ipsum venerere licebit</l>
  <l n="307">Quod iuvat, et quae dat gaudia voce notes.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="308">Ut fuerit torva violentior illa Medusa,</l>
  <l n="309">Fiet amatori lenis et aequa suo.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="310">Tantum, ne pateas verbis simulator in illis,</l>
  <l n="311">Effice, nec vultu destrue dicta tuo.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="312">Si latet, ars prodest: adfert deprensa pudorem,</l>
  <l n="313">Atque adimit merito tempus in omne fidem.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="314">Saepe sub autumnum, cum formosissimus annus,</l>
  <l n="315">Plenaque purpureo subrubet uva mero,</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="316">Cum modo frigoribus premimur, modo solvimur aestu,</l>
  <l n="317">Aere non certo, corpora languor habet.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="318">Illa quidem valeat; sed si male firma cubarit,</l>
  <l n="319">Et vitium caeli senserit aegra sui,</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="320">Tunc amor et pietas tua sit manifesta puellae,</l>
  <l n="321">Tum sere, quod plena postmodo falce metas.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="322">Nec tibi morosi veniant fastidia morbi,</l>
  <l n="323">Perque tuas fiant, quae sinet ipsa, manus.</l>
</lg>
morceaux.12:
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="325">Et videat flentem, nec taedeat oscula ferre,</l>
  <l n="326">Et sicco lacrimas conbibat ore tuas.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="327">Multa vove, sed cuncta palam; quotiesque libebit,</l>
  <l n="328">Quae referas illi, somnia laeta vide.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="329">Et veniat, quae lustret anus lectumque locumque,</l>
  <l n="330">Praeferat et tremula sulpur et ova manu.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="331">Omnibus his inerunt gratae vestigia curae:</l>
  <l n="332">In tabulas multis haec via fecit iter.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="333">Nec tamen officiis odium quaeratur ab aegra:</l>
  <l n="334">Sit suus in blanda sedulitate modus:</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="335">Neve cibo prohibe, nec amari pocula suci</l>
  <l n="336">Porrige: rivalis misceat illa tuus.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="337">Sed non cui dederas a litore carbasa vento,</l>
  <l n="338">Utendum, medio cum potiere freto.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="339">Dum novus errat amor, vires sibi colligat usu:</l>
  <l n="340">Si bene nutrieris, tempore firmus erit.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="341">Quem taurum metuis, vitulum mulcere solebas:</l>
  <l n="342">Sub qua nunc recubas arbore, virga fuit:</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="343">Nascitur exiguus, sed opes adquirit eundo,</l>
  <l n="344">Quaque venit, multas accipit amnis aquas.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="345">Fac tibi consuescat: nil adsuetudine maius:</l>
  <l n="346">Quam tu dum capias, taedia nulla fuge.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="347">Te semper videat, tibi semper praebeat aures;</l>
  <l n="348">Exhibeat vultus noxque diesque tuos.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="349">Cum tibi maior erit fiducia, posse requiri,</l>
  <l n="350">Cum procul absenti cura futurus eris,</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="351">Da requiem: requietus ager bene credita reddit,</l>
  <l n="352">Terraque caelestes arida sorbet aquas.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="353">Phyllida Demophoon praesens moderatius ussit:</l>
  <l n="354">Exarsit velis acrius illa datis.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="355">Penelopen absens sollers torquebat Ulixes;</l>
  <l n="356">Phylacides aberat, Laodamia, tuus.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="357">Sed mora tuta brevis: lentescunt tempore curae,</l>
</lg>
morceaux.13:
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="359">Vanescitque absens et <foreign xml:lang="la">novus</foreign> intrat <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">amor</name>.</l>
  <l n="360">Dum <persName>Menelaus</persName> abest, <persName>Helene</persName>, ne sola iaceret,</l>
  <l n="361">Hospitis est tepido nocte recepta sinu.</l>
  <l n="362">Quis stupor hic, <persName>Menelae</persName>, fuit? tu solus abibas,</l>
  <l n="363">Isdem sub tectis hospes et uxor erant.</l>
  <l n="364">Accipitri timidas credis, furiose, <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">columbas</name>?</l>
  <l n="365">Plenum montano credis ovile <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">lupo</name>?</l>
  <l n="366">Nil <persName>Helene</persName> peccat, nihil hic committit adulter:</l>
  <l n="367">Quod tu, quod faceret quilibet, ille facit.</l>
  <l n="368">Cogis adulterium dando tempusque locumque;</l>
  <l n="369">Quid nisi consilio est usa puella tuo?</l>
  <l n="370">Quid faciat? vir abest, et adest non rusticus hospes,</l>
  <l n="371">Et timet in vacuo sola cubare toro.</l>
  <l n="372">Viderit <persName>Atrides</persName>: <persName>Helenen</persName> ego crimine solvo:</l>
  <l n="373">Usa est humani commoditate viri.</l>
  <l n="374">Sed neque <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">fulvus aper</name> media tam saevus in ira est,</l>
  <l n="375">Fulmineo rabidos cum rotat ore <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">canes</name>,</l>
  <l n="376">Nec <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">lea</name>, cum catulis lactentibus ubera praebet,</l>
  <l n="377">Nec brevis <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">vipera</name> laesa pede,</l>
  <l n="378"><name type="animal" xml:lang="la">Femina</name> quam socii deprensa paelice lecti:</l>
  <l n="379">Ardet et in vultu pignora mentis habet.</l>
  <l n="380">In ferrum flammasque ruit, positoque decore</l>
  <l n="381">Fertur, ut <name type="deity">Aonii</name> cornibus icta <name type="deity">dei</name>.</l>
  <l n="382">Coniugis admissum violataque iura marita est</l>
  <l n="383">Barbara per natos <placeName>Phasias</placeName> ulta suos.</l>
  <l n="384">Altera dira parens haec est, quam cernis, <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">hirundo</name>:</l>
  <l n="385">Aspice, signatum <foreign xml:lang="la">sanguine</foreign> pectus habet.</l>
  <l n="386">Hoc bene compositos, hoc firmos solvit amores;</l>
  <l n="387">Crimina sunt cautis ista timenda viris.</l>
  <l n="388">Nec mea vos uni damnat censura puellae:</l>
  <l n="389">Di melius! vix hoc nupta tenere potest.</l>
  <l n="390">Ludite, sed furto celetur culpa modesto:</l>
</lg>
morceaux.14:
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="390">Gloria peccati nulla petenda <name type="deity">sui</name> est.</l>
  <l n="391">Nec dederis munus, cognosse quod altera possit,</l>
  <l n="392">Nec sint nequitiae tempora certa tuae.</l>
  <l n="393">Et, ne te capiat latebris sibi <persName>femina</persName> notis,</l>
  <l n="394">Non uno est omnis convenienda loco;</l>
  <l n="395">Et quotiens scribes, totas prius ipse tabellas</l>
  <l n="396">Inspice: plus multae, quam sibi missa, legunt.</l>
  <l n="397"><name type="deity">Laesa Venus</name> iusta arma movet, telumque remittit,</l>
  <l n="398">Et, modo quod questa est, ipse querare, facit.</l>
  <l n="399">Dum fuit <persName>Atrides</persName> una contentus, et illa</l>
  <l n="400">Casta fuit: vitio est improba facta viri.</l>
  <l n="401">Audierat <name type="plant" xml:lang="la">laurum</name>que manu vittasque ferentem</l>
  <l n="402">Pro nata <placeName>Chrysen</placeName> non valuisse sua:</l>
  <l n="403">Audierat, <placeName>Lyrnesi</placeName>, tuos, abducta, dolores,</l>
  <l n="404">Bellaque per turpis longius isse moras.</l>
  <l n="405">Haec tamen audierat: <persName>Priameida</persName> viderat ipsa:</l>
  <l n="406">Victor erat praedae praeda pudenda suae.</l>
  <l n="407">Inde <persName>Thyestiaden</persName> animo thalamoque recepit,</l>
  <l n="408">Et male peccantem <persName>Tyndaris</persName> ulta virum.</l>
  <l n="409">Quae bene celaris, siqua tamen acta patebunt,</l>
  <l n="410">Illa, licet pateant, tu tamen usque nega.</l>
  <l n="411">Tum neque subiectus, solito nec blandior esto:</l>
  <l n="412">Haec animi multum signa nocentis habent:</l>
  <l n="413">Sed lateri ne parce tuo: pax omnis in uno est;</l>
  <l n="414">Concubitu prior est infitianda venus.</l>
  <l n="415">Sunt, qui praecipiant herbas, <name type="plant" xml:lang="la">satureia</name>, nocentes</l>
  <l n="416">Sumere; iudiciis ista venena meis;</l>
  <l n="417">Aut <name type="plant" xml:lang="la">piper</name> <name type="plant" xml:lang="la">urticae</name> mordacis semine miscent,</l>
  <l n="418">Tritaque in annoso flava <name type="plant" xml:lang="la">pyrethra</name> mero;</l>
  <l n="419">Sed <name type="deity">dea</name> non patitur sic ad sua gaudia cogi,</l>
  <l n="420">Colle sub umbroso quam tenet altus <placeName>Eryx</placeName>.</l>
  <l n="421">Candidus, <placeName>Alcathoi</placeName> qui mittitur urbe <foreign xml:lang="grc">Pelasga</foreign>,</l>
</lg>
morceaux.15:
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="421">Bulbus et, ex <name type="plant" xml:lang="la">horto</name> quae venit, <name type="plant" xml:lang="la">herba</name> <foreign xml:lang="la">salax</foreign></l>
  <l n="422"><name type="animal" xml:lang="la">Ova</name>que sumantur, sumantur <name type="placeName">Hymettia</name> <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">mella</name>,</l>
  <l n="423">Quasque tulit folio <name type="plant" xml:lang="la">pinus</name> acuta <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">nuces</name>.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="424">Docta, quid ad magicas, <persName>Erato</persName>, deverteris artes?</l>
  <l n="425">Interior curru meta terenda meo est.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="426">Qui modo celabas monitu tua crimina nostro,</l>
  <l n="427">Flecte iter, et monitu detege furta meo.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="428">Nec levitas culpanda mea est: non semper eodem</l>
  <l n="429">Impositos vento panda carina vehit.</l>
  <l n="430">Nam modo <placeName>Threicio</placeName> <name type="deity">Borea</name>, modo currimus <name type="deity">Euro</name>,</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="429">Saep<supplied reason="omitted">e</supplied> tument <name type="deity">Zephyro</name> lintea, saepe <name type="deity">Noto</name>.</l>
  <l n="430">Aspice, ut in curru modo det fluitantia rector</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="431">Lora, modo admissos arte retentet equos.</l>
  <l n="432">Sunt quibus ingrate timida indulgentia servit,</l>
  <l n="433">Et, si nulla subest aemula, languet amor.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="434">Luxuriant animi rebus plerumque secundis,</l>
  <l n="435">Nec facile est aequa commoda mente pati.</l>
  <l n="436">Ut levis absumptis paulatim viribus ignis</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="437">Ipse latet, summo canet in igne cinis,</l>
  <l n="438">Sed tamen extinctas admoto sulpure flammas</l>
  <l n="439">Invenit, et lumen, quod fuit ante, redit:</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="440">Sic, ubi pigra situ securaque pectora torpent,</l>
  <l n="441">Acribus est stimulis eliciendus amor.</l>
  <l n="442">Fac timeat de te, tepidamque recalface mentem:</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="443">Palleat indicio criminis illa tui;</l>
  <l n="444">O quater et quotiens numero conprendere non est</l>
  <l n="445">Felicem, de quo laesa puella dolet:</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="446">Quae, simul invitas crimen pervenit ad aures,</l>
  <l n="447">Excidit, et miserae voxque colorque fugit.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="448">Ille ego sim, cuius laniet furiosa capillos:</l>
  <l n="449">Ille ego sim, teneras cui petat ungue genas,</l>
  <l n="450">Quem videat lacrimans, quem torvis spectet ocellis,</l>
</lg>
morceaux.16:
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="454">Quo sine non possit vivere, posse velit.</l>
  <l n="455">Si spatium quaeras, breve sit, quo laesa queratur,</l>
  <l n="456">Ne lenta vires colligat ira mora;</l>
  <l n="457">Candida iamdudum cingantur colla <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">lacertis</name>,</l>
  <l n="458">Inque tuos flens est accipienda sinus.</l>
  <l n="459">Oscula da flenti, <name type="deity">Veneris</name> da gaudia flenti,</l>
  <l n="460">Pax erit: hoc uno solvitur ira modo.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="461">Cum bene saevierit, cum certa videbitur hostis,</l>
  <l n="462">Tum pete concubitus foedera, mitis erit.</l>
  <l n="463">Illic depositis habitat Concordia telis:</l>
  <l n="464">Illo, crede mihi, Gratia nata loco est.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="465">Quae modo pugnarunt, iungunt sua rostra <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">columbae</name>,</l>
  <l n="466">Quarum blanditias verbaque murmur habet.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="467">Prima fuit rerum confusa sine ordine moles,</l>
  <l n="468">Unaque erat facies sidera, terra, fretum;</l>
  <l n="469">Mox caelum impositum terris, humus aequore cincta est</l>
  <l n="470">Inque suas partes cessit inane chaos;</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="471">Silva <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">feras</name>, volucres aer accepit habendas,</l>
  <l n="472">In liquida, <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">pisces</name>, delituistis aqua.</l>
  <l n="473">Tum genus humanum solis errabat in agris,</l>
  <l n="474">Idque merae vires et rude corpus erat;</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="475">Silva domus fuerat, cibus <name type="plant" xml:lang="la">herba</name>, cubilia <name type="plant" xml:lang="la">frondes</name>:</l>
  <l n="476">Iamque diu nulli cognitus alter erat.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="477">Blanda truces animos fertur mollisse voluptas:</l>
  <l n="478">Constiterant uno femina virque loco;</l>
  <l n="479">Quid facerent, ipsi nullo didicere magistro:</l>
  <l n="480">Arte <name type="deity">Venus</name> nulla dulce peregit opus.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="481"><name type="animal" xml:lang="la">Ales</name> habet, quod amet; cum quo sua gaudia iungat,</l>
  <l n="482">Invenit in media femina <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">piscis</name> aqua;</l>
  <l n="483"><name type="animal" xml:lang="la">Cerva</name> parem sequitur, <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">serpens</name> serpente tenetur,</l>
  <l n="484">Haeret adulterio cum <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">cane</name> nexa <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">canis</name>;</l>
  <l n="485">Laeta salitur ovis: <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">tauro</name> quoque laeta iuvenca est:</l>
</lg>
morceaux.17:
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="487">Sustinet inmundum <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">sima</name> <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">capella</name> <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">marem</name>;</l>
  <l n="488">In furias agitantur <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">equae</name>, spatioque remota</l>
  <l n="489">Per loca dividuos amne sequuntur <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">equos</name>.</l>
  <l n="490">Ergo age et iratae medicamina fortia praebe:</l>
  <l n="491">Illa feri requiem sola doloris habent:</l>
  <l n="492">Illa Machaonios superant medicamina sucos:</l>
  <l n="493">His, ubi peccaris, restituendus eris.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="494">Haec ego cum canerem, subito manifestus <persName>Apollo</persName></l>
  <l n="495">Movit inauratae pollice fila lyrae.</l>
  <l n="496">In manibus laurus, sacris inducta capillis</l>
  <l n="497">Laurus erat; vates ille videndus adit.</l>
  <l n="498">Is mihi 'Lascivi' dixit 'praeceptor <name type="deity">Amoris</name>,</l>
  <l n="499">Duc, age, discipulos ad mea templa tuos,</l>
  <l n="500">Est ubi diversum fama celebrata per orbem</l>
  <l n="501">Littera, cognosci quae sibi quemque iubet.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="502">Qui sibi notus erit, solus sapienter amabit,</l>
  <l n="503">Atque opus ad vires exiget omne suas.</l>
  <l n="504">Cui faciem natura dedit, spectetur ab illa:</l>
  <l n="505">Cui color est, umero saepe patente cubet:</l>
  <l n="506">Qui sermone placet, taciturna silentia vitet:</l>
  <l n="507">Qui canit arte, canat; qui bibit arte, bibat.</l>
  <l n="508">Sed neque declament medio sermone diserti,</l>
  <l n="509">Nec sua non sanus scripta poeta legat!'</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="510">Sic monuit <name type="deity">Phoebus</name>: <persName>Phoebo</persName> parete monenti;</l>
  <l n="511">Certa dei sacro est huius in ore fides.</l>
  <l n="512">Ad propiora vocor. Quisquis sapienter amabit</l>
  <l n="513">Vincet, et e nostra, quod petet, arte feret.</l>
  <l n="514">Credita non semper sulci cum faenore reddunt,</l>
  <l n="515">Nec semper dubias adiuvat aura rates;</l>
  <l n="516">Quod iuvat, exiguum, plus est, quod laedat amantes;</l>
  <l n="517">Proponant animo multa ferenda suo.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="518">Quot <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">lepores</name> in <placeName>Atho</placeName>, quot <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">apes</name> pascuntur in <placeName>Hybla</placeName>,</l>
</lg>
morceaux.18:
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="520">Caerula quot <name type="plant" xml:lang="la">bacas</name> <name type="deity" xml:lang="la">Palladis</name> <name type="plant" xml:lang="la">arbor</name> habet,</l>
  <l n="521"><name type="placeName">Litore</name> quot <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">conchae</name>, tot sunt in <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">amore</name> <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">dolores</name>;</l>
  <l n="522">Quae patimur, multo <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">spicula</name> <foreign xml:lang="la">felle</foreign> madent.</l>
  <l n="523"><quote>Dicta</quote> erit isse foras: intus fortasse videre est:</l>
  <l n="524">Isse foras, et te falsa videre puta.</l>
  <l n="525">Clausa tibi fuerit promissa ianua nocte:</l>
  <l n="526">Perfer et inmunda ponere <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">corpus</name> <name type="placeName">humo</name>.</l>
  <l n="527">Forsitan et vultu mendax <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">ancilla</name> superbo</l>
  <l n="528"><quote>Dicet</quote> 'quid nostras obsidet iste <name type="placeName">fores</name>'?</l>
  <l n="529">Postibus et durae supplex blandire <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">puellae</name>,</l>
  <l n="530">Et <name type="plant" xml:lang="la">capiti</name> demptas in <name type="placeName">fore</name> pone <name type="plant" xml:lang="la">rosas</name>.</l>
  <l n="531">Cum volet, accedes: cum te vitabit, abibis;</l>
  <l n="532"><name type="animal" xml:lang="la">Dedecet</name> <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">ingenuos</name> <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">taedia</name> ferre sui.</l>
  <l n="533">'Effugere hunc non est' quare tibi possit <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">amica</name></l>
  <l n="534"><quote>Dicere</quote>? non omni <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">tempore</name> <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">sensus</name> obest.</l>
  <l n="535">Nec <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">maledicta</name> puta, nec <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">verbera</name> ferre <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">puellae</name></l>
  <l n="536">Turpe, nec ad teneros <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">oscula</name> ferre <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">pedes</name>.</l>
  <l n="537">Quid moror in parvis? <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">Animus</name> maioribus instat;</l>
  <l n="538"><name type="animal" xml:lang="la">Magna</name> canam: toto <name type="plant" xml:lang="la">pectore</name>, <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">vulgus</name>, ades.</l>
  <l n="539">Ardua molimur, sed nulla, nisi ardua, <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">virtus</name>:</l>
  <l n="540"><name type="animal" xml:lang="la">Difficilis</name> nostra poscitur <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">arte</name> <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">labor</name>.</l>
  <l n="541"><name type="animal" xml:lang="la">Rivalem</name> patienter habe, <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">victoria</name> tecum</l>
  <l n="542">Stabit: eris magni victor in arce <name type="deity" xml:lang="la">Iovis</name>.</l>
  <l n="543"><name type="animal" xml:lang="la">Haec</name> tibi non <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">hominem</name>, sed <name type="plant" xml:lang="la">quercus</name> crede <name type="persName">Pelasgas</name></l>
  <l n="544"><quote>Dicere</quote>: nil istis <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">ars</name> mea maius habet.</l>
  <l n="545"><name type="animal" xml:lang="la">Innuet</name> illa, <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">feras</name>; scribet, ne tange <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">tabellas</name>:</l>
  <l n="546">Unde volet, veniat; quoque libebit, eat.</l>
  <l n="547"><quote>Hoc</quote> in legitima praestant <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">uxore</name> <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">mariti</name>,</l>
  <l n="548">Cum, tener, ad partes tu quoque, <name type="deity" xml:lang="la">somme</name>, venis.</l>
  <l n="549">Hac ego, confiteor, non sum perfectus in <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">arte</name>;</l>
  <l n="550">Quid faciam? monitis sum minor ipse meis.</l>
  <l n="551">Mene palam nostrae det quisquam <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">signa</name> <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">puellae</name>,</l>
</lg>
morceaux.19:
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="550">Et patiar, nec me quo libet ira ferat?</l>
  <l n="551">Oscula <persName>vir</persName> dederat, memini, suus: oscula questus</l>
  <l n="552">Sum data; barbaria noster abundat amor.</l>
  <l n="553">Non semel hoc vitium nocuit mihi: doctior ille,</l>
  <l n="554">Quo veniunt alii conciliante <persName>viri</persName>.</l>
  <l n="555">Sed melius nescisse fuit: sine furta tegantur,</l>
  <l n="556">Ne fugiat ficto fassus ab ore pudor.</l>
  <l n="557">Quo magis, o <persName>iuvenes</persName>, deprendere parcite vestras:</l>
  <l n="558">Peccent, peccantes verba dedisse putent.</l>
  <l n="559">Crescit amor prensis; ubi par fortuna duorum est,</l>
  <l n="560">In causa damni perstat uterque sui.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="561">Fabula narratur toto notissima caelo,</l>
  <l n="562"><name type="deity" xml:lang="la">Mulciberis</name> capti <name type="deity" xml:lang="la">Mars</name>que <name type="deity" xml:lang="la">Venus</name>que dolis.</l>
  <l n="563"><name type="deity" xml:lang="la">Mars</name> pater, insano <name type="deity" xml:lang="la">Veneris</name> turbatus amore,</l>
  <l n="564">De duce terribili factus amator erat.</l>
  <l n="565">Nec <name type="deity" xml:lang="la">Venus</name> oranti (neque enim dea mollior ulla est)</l>
  <l n="566"><foreign xml:lang="la">Rustica</foreign> <name type="deity" xml:lang="la">Gradivo</name> difficilisque fuit.</l>
  <l n="567">A, quotiens lasciva pedes risisse mariti</l>
  <l n="568">Dicitur, et duras igne vel arte manus.</l>
  <l n="569">Marte palam simul est <name type="deity" xml:lang="la">Vulcanum</name> imitata, decebat,</l>
  <l n="570">Multaque cum forma gratia mixta fuit.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="571">Sed bene concubitus primos celare solebant.</l>
  <l n="572">Plena verecundi culpa pudoris erat.</l>
  <l n="573">Indicio <name type="deity" xml:lang="la">Solis</name> (quis Solem fallere possit?)</l>
  <l n="574">Cognita <name type="deity" xml:lang="la">Vulcano</name> coniugis acta suae.</l>
  <l n="575">Quam mala, <name type="deity" xml:lang="la">Sol</name>, exempla moves! Pete munus ab ipsa</l>
  <l n="576">Et tibi, si taceas, quod dare possit, habet.</l>
  <l n="577"><name type="deity" xml:lang="la">Mulciber</name> obscuros lectum circaque superque</l>
  <l n="578">Disponit laqueos: lumina fallit opus.</l>
  <l n="579">Fingit iter <placeName>Lemnon</placeName>; veniunt ad foedus amantes:</l>
  <l n="580">Impliciti laqueis nudus uterque iacent.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="581">Convocat ille deos; praebent spectacula capti:</l>
</lg>
morceaux.20:
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="581">Vix lacrimas Venerem continuisse putant.</l>
  <l n="582">Non vultus texisse suos, non denique possunt</l>
  <l n="583">Partibus obscenis opposuisse manus.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="584">Hic aliquis ridens 'in me, fortissime <persName>Mavors</persName>,'</l>
  <l n="585">Si tibi sunt oneri, vincula transfer!' ait.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="586">Vix precibus, <persName>Neptune</persName>, tuis captiva resolvit</l>
  <l n="587">Corpora: <persName>Mars</persName> <placeName>Thracen</placeName> occupat, illa <placeName>Paphon</placeName>.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="588">Hoc tibi pro facto, <persName>Vulcane</persName>: quod ante tegebant,</l>
  <l n="589">Liberius faciunt, ut pudor omnis abest:</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="590">Saepe tamen demens stulte fecisse fateris,</l>
  <l n="591">Teque ferunt artis paenituisse tuae.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="592">Hoc vetiti vos este; vetat deprensa <persName>Dione</persName></l>
  <l n="593">Insidias illas, quas tulit ipsa, dare.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="584">Nec vos rivali laqueos disponite, nec vos</l>
  <l n="595">Excipite arcana verba notata manu.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="596">Ista viri captent, si iam captanda putabunt,</l>
  <l n="597">Quos faciet iustos ignis et unda viros.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="598">En, iterum testor: nihil hic, nisi lege remissum</l>
  <l n="599">Luditur: in nostris instita nulla iocis.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="600">Quis <name type="deity">Cereri</name> ritus ausit vulgare profanis,</l>
  <l n="601">Magnaque <placeName>Threicia</placeName> sacra reperta <placeName>Samo</placeName>?</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="602">Exigua est virtus praestare silentia rebus:</l>
  <l n="603">At contra gravis est culpa tacenda loqui.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="604">O bene, quod frustra captatis arbore pomis</l>
  <l n="605">Garrulus in media <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">Tantalus</name> aret aqua!</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="606">Praecipue <persName>Cytherea</persName> iubet sua sacra taceri:</l>
  <l n="607">Admoneo, veniat nequis ad illa loquax.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="608">Condita si non sunt <persName>Veneris</persName> mysteria cistis,</l>
  <l n="609">Nec cava vesanis ictibus aera sonant,</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="610">At sic inter nos medio versantur in usu,</l>
  <l n="611">Se tamen inter nos ut latuisse velint.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="612">Ipsa <persName>Venus</persName> pubem, quotiens velamina ponit,</l>
  <l n="613">Protegitur laeva semireducta manu.</l>
</lg>
morceaux.21:
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="615">In medio passimque coit <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">pecus</name>: hoc quoque viso</l>
  <l n="616">Avertit vultus nempe puella suos.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="617">Conveniunt thalami furtis et ianua nostris,</l>
  <l n="618">Parsque sub iniecta veste pudenda latet:</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="619">Et si non tenebras, ad quiddam nubis opacae</l>
  <l n="620">Quaerimus, atque aliquid luce patente minus.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="621">Tum quoque, cum solem nondum prohibebat et imbrem</l>
  <l n="622">Tegula, sed <name type="plant" xml:lang="la">quercus</name> tecta cibumque dabat,</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="623">In nemore atque antris, non sub <name type="deity">Iove</name>, iuncta voluptas;</l>
  <l n="624">Tanta rudi populo cura pudoris erat.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="625">At nunc nocturnis titulos inponimus actis,</l>
  <l n="626">Atque emitur magno nil, nisi posse loqui!</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="627">Scilicet excuties omnes, ubi quaeque, puellas,</l>
  <l n="628">Cuilibet ut dicas 'haec quoque nostra fuit,'</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="629">Nec desint, quas tu digitis ostendere possis?</l>
  <l n="630">Ut quamque adtigeris, fabula turpis erit?</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="631">Parva queror: fingunt quidam, quae vera negarent,</l>
  <l n="632">Et nulli non se concubuisse ferunt.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="633">Corpora si nequeunt, quae possunt, nomina tangunt,</l>
  <l n="634">Famaque non tacto corpore crimen habet.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="635">I nunc, claude fores, custos odiose puellae,</l>
  <l n="636">Et centum duris postibus obde seras!</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="637">Quid tuti superest, cum nominis extat adulter,</l>
  <l n="638">Et credi quod non contigit esse, cupit?</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="639">Nos etiam veros parce profitemur amores,</l>
  <l n="640">Tectaque sunt solida mystica furta fide.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="641">Parcite praecipue vitia exprobrare puellis,</l>
  <l n="642">Utile quae multis dissimulasse fuit.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="643">Nec suus <name type="person">Andromedae</name> color est obiectus ab illo,</l>
  <l n="644">Mobilis in gemino cui pede <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">pinna</name> fuit.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="645">Omnibus <name type="person">Andromache</name> visa est spatiosior aequo:</l>
  <l n="646">Unus, qui modicam diceret, <name type="person">Hector</name> erat.</l>
</lg>
morceaux.22:
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="649">Quod male fers, adsuesce, feres bene; multa vetustus</l>
  <l n="650">Leniet, incipiens omnia sentit amor.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="651">Dum novus in viridi coalescit cortice <name type="plant" xml:lang="la">ramus</name>,</l>
  <l n="652">Concutiat tenerum quaelibet aura, cadet:</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="653">Mox eadem ventis, spatio durata, resistet,</l>
  <l n="654">Firmaque adoptivas <name type="plant" xml:lang="la">arbor</name> habebit opes.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="655">Eximit ipsa dies omnes e corpore mendas,</l>
  <l n="656">Quodque fuit vitium, desinit esse mora.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="657">Ferre novae nares <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">taurorum</name> terga recusant:</l>
  <l n="658">Adsiduo domitas tempore fallit odor.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="659">Nominibus mollire licet mala: fusca vocetur,</l>
  <l n="660">Nigrior Illyrica cui <foreign xml:lang="la">pice</foreign> sanguis erit:</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="661">Si straba, sit Veneri similis: si rava, Minervae:</l>
  <l n="662">Sit gracilis, macie quae male viva sua est;</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="663">Dic habilem, quaecumque brevis, quae turgida, plenam,</l>
  <l n="664">Et lateat vitium proximitate boni.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="665">Nec quotus annus eat, nec quo sit nata, require,</l>
  <l n="666">Consule, quae rigidus munera Censor habet:</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="667">Praecipue si flore caret, meliusque peractum</l>
  <l n="668">Tempus, et albentes iam legit illa comas.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="669">Utilis, o <persName>iuvenes</persName>, aut haec, aut serior aetas:</l>
  <l n="670">Iste feret segetes, iste serendus ager.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="671">Dum vires annique sinunt, tolerate labores:</l>
  <l n="672">Iam veniet tacito curva senecta pede.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="673">Aut mare remigiis, aut vomere findite terras,</l>
  <l n="674">Aut fera belligeras addite in arma manus,</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="675">Aut latus et vires operamque adferte puellis:</l>
  <l n="676">Hoc quoque militia est, hoc quoque quaerit opes.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="677">Adde, quod est illis operum prudentia maior,</l>
  <l n="678">Solus et artifices qui facit, usus adest:</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="679">Illae munditiis annorum damna rependunt,</l>
  <l n="680">Et faciunt cura, ne videantur anus.</l>
</lg>
morceaux.23:
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="680">Utque velis, venerem iungunt per mille figuras:</l>
  <l n="681">Invenit plures nulla tabella modos.</l>
  <l n="682">Illis sentitur non inritata voluptas:</l>
  <l n="683">Quod iuvet, ex aequo femina virque ferant.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="684">Odi concubitus, qui non utrumque resolvunt;</l>
  <l n="685">Hoc est, cur pueri tangar amore minus.</l>
  <l n="686">Odi quae praebet, quia sit praebere necesse,</l>
  <l n="687">Siccaque de lana cogitat ipsa sua.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="688">Quae datur officio, non est mihi grata voluptas:</l>
  <l n="689">Officium faciat nulla puella mihi.</l>
  <l n="690">Me voces audire iuvat sua gaudia fassas,</l>
  <l n="691">Quaeque morer meme sustineamque rogent.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="692">Aspiciam dominae victos amentis ocellos:</l>
  <l n="693">Langueat, et tangi se vetet illa diu.</l>
  <l n="694">Haec bona non primae tribuit natura iuventae,</l>
  <l n="695">Quae cito post septem lustra venire solent.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="696">Qui properant, nova musta bibant: mihi fundat avitum</l>
  <l n="697">Consulibus priscis condita testa merum.</l>
  <l n="698">Nec platanus, nisi sera, potest obsistere Phoebo,</l>
  <l n="699">Et laedunt nudos prata novella pedes.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="700">Scilicet Hermionen Helenae praeponere posses,</l>
  <l n="701">Et melior Gorge, quam sua mater, erat?</l>
  <l n="702">At venerem quicumque voles adtingere seram,</l>
  <l n="703">Si modo duraris, praemia digna feres.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="704">Conscius, ecce, duos accepit lectus amantes:</l>
  <l n="705">Ad thalami clausas, Musa, resiste fores.</l>
  <l n="706">Sponte sua sine te celeberrima verba loquentur,</l>
  <l n="707">Nec manus in lecto laeva iacebit iners.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="708">Invenient digiti, quod agant in partibus illis,</l>
  <l n="709">In quibus occulte spicula tingit Amor.</l>
  <l n="710">Fecit in Andromache prius hoc fortissimus Hector,</l>
  <l n="711">Nec solum bellis utilis ille fuit.</l>
</lg>
morceaux.24:
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="711">Fecit et in capta <name type="placeName" xml:lang="la">Lyrneside</name> magnus <persName>Achilles</persName>,</l>
  <l n="712">Cum premeret mollem lassus ab hoste torum.</l>
  <l n="713">Illis te manibus tangi, <persName>Brisei</persName>, sinebas,</l>
  <l n="714">Imbutae <name type="placeName" xml:lang="la">Phrygia</name> quae nece semper erant.</l>
  <l n="715">An fuit hoc ipsum, quod te, lasciva, iuvaret,</l>
  <l n="716">Ad tua victrices membra venire manus?</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="717">Crede mihi, non est veneris properanda voluptas,</l>
  <l n="718">Sed sensim tarda prolicienda mora.</l>
  <l n="719">Cum loca reppereris, quae tangi femina gaudet,</l>
  <l n="720">Non obstet, tangas quo minus illa, pudor.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="721">Aspicies oculos tremulo fulgore micantes,</l>
  <l n="722">Ut sol a liquida saepe refulget aqua.</l>
  <l n="723">Accedent questus, accedet amabile murmur,</l>
  <l n="724">Et dulces gemitus aptaque verba ioco.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="725">Sed neque tu dominam velis maioribus usus</l>
  <l n="726">Desere, nec cursus anteat illa tuos;</l>
  <l n="727">Ad metam properate simul: tum plena voluptas,</l>
  <l n="728">Cum pariter victi femina virque iacent.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="729">Hic tibi versandus tenor est, cum libera dantur</l>
  <l n="730">Otia, furtivum nec timor urget opus.</l>
  <l n="731">Cum mora non tuta est, totis incumbere remis</l>
  <l n="732">Utile, et admisso subdere calcar equo.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="733">Finis adest operi: palmam date, grata iuventus,</l>
  <l n="734">Sertaque odoratae <name type="plant" xml:lang="la">myrtea</name> ferte comae.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="735">Quantus apud <persName>Danaos</persName> <persName>Podalirius</persName> arte medendi,</l>
  <l n="736">Aeacides dextra, pectore <persName>Nestor</persName> erat,</l>
  <l n="737">Quantus erat <persName>Calchas</persName> extis, <persName>Telamonius</persName> armis,</l>
  <l n="738">Automedon curru, tantus amator ego.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="739">Me vatem celebrate, viri, mihi dicite laudes,</l>
  <l n="740">Cantetur toto nomen in orbe meum.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="741">Arma dedi vobis: dederat <name type="deity" xml:lang="la">Vulcanus</name> <persName>Achilli</persName>;</l>
  <l n="742">Vincite muneribus, vicit ut ille, datis.</l>
</lg>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="743">Sed quicumque meo superarit <name type="animal" xml:lang="la">Amazona</name> ferro,</l>
</lg>
morceaux.25:
<head>Halieutica</head>
<lg type="strophe">
  <l n="745">Inscribat spoliis 'Naso magister erat.'</l>
  <l>Ecce, rogant tenerae, sibi dem praecepta, puellae:</l>
  <l>Vos eritis chartae proxima cura meae!</l>
</lg>
<persName>Ovidius</persName>
